data.long_meaning: Ram means 'God' and Chandra means 'moon'. Ramchandr is a name of Lord Rama, who is considered to be the god of gods in Hinduism. He is the embodiment of power, strength, and courage. The name Ramchandr carries the meaning “God of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramchandr usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramchandr total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
